# Changelog

## 0.7.1 - 2026-11-04

- First version: 中央社新聞 CNA TAIWAN NEWS remote MCP server over streamable HTTP.
- Endpoint taken from the Claude connector directory listing for 中央社新聞 CNA TAIWAN NEWS.
- The auth mode is OAuth. The server answered an anonymous request with a 401 and a link to its OAuth metadata. BoldCreate Connect supplies its own OAuth client.
